ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.

2. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

3. When learning Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

6. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.

7. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

8. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.

9. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.

10. When learning Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.

13. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

14. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.

15. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

16. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain D.C Electric Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Cells and Batteries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Capacitors and Capacitance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
